mostWorthwhile.text: Loading the two complete cores separately and connecting their carrier to flight cooling made the preservation sequence feel purposeful and physically sensible.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial bench inspection was less engaging because it had only one available operation and performed it automatically, though it clarified the carrier's preparation.

surprise.text: The cold bench automatically chilled both the carrier and its transfer buffer; the buffer later bridged the handoff to flight cooling.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; each transfer had a clear preservation or stowage purpose.

continue.text: I would continue to see what happens to the specimens and their discovery, although this chapter's mostly straightforward packing sequence offered few meaningful choices.
